description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides WebAssembly integration for an image optimization function called 'optimise'. It manages WebAssembly memory, loads the wasm module asynchronously, and exports the 'optimise' function for external use.

methods.name: optimise
methods.description: Performs image optimization using WebAssembly, taking a Uint8Array and a level parameter, returning a Uint8Array.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and instantiates a WebAssembly module from a Response or other module source.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the WebAssembly module, setting up imports and loading the wasm binary.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Manually clears references to wasm and memory buffers to trigger garbage collection.
